 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order

1. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 38/2022 of Police Station Mandawali Fazal Pur for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
2. Learned APP accepts notice and submits that he has no objection to this petition.
3. Respondent no.2 indentified by IO/ASI Surendra Singh accepts notice.
4. For recording statement of parties, list before the Joint Registrar on 09.04.2026.
